messages:
kevin: Quick Q — planning a contract change on /v1/generate that would make the default model pointer move to `latest-stable`. Concern: many clients don't specify model_version and rely on current stable default. Need consensus on backward-compat, timelines, and comms.

maria: Do we have telemetry on how many requests omit model_version? Can we do per-customer fallbacks instead of a global switch? @diane any numbers?

diane: Telemetry: ~42% of hosted tokens omit model_version, mostly small PLG apps. We can do per-customer pinning but rollout complexity increases. Also customers on Dedicated often already pin.

kevin: Proposal: 1) Add explicit query param `model_version` + header `X-Model-Pinned`. 2) Emit warning header when omitted. 3) Keep current default for 6 months. 4) After 6 months start soft-default behind feature-flag for a subset. 5) 90-day deprecation notice before any hard switch. Example response header idea: `X-Model-Change-Notice: pin-or-upgrade-by=2024-10-01`

alex: +1. Also add a CI compatibility test: compare outputs for pinned vs latest on our eval suite; if divergence > threshold, fail. For Dedicated customers send a 30-day heads-up email before any soft-default flip.

maria: SDKs: add explicit param in client constructors now (non-breaking), log warning when using implicit default. Add migration guide in docs.

diane: I'll draft the RFC and timeline. Action items: telemetry owner to confirm % by EOD, eng-platform to add header + param, SDK leads to add param & warning logs, docs to draft migration guide and comms.

kevin: /cc @deploy-bot can we emit a metric `api.model.default_warning` whenever default is used? Also API lint rule to block breaking change merges without RFC.

deploy-bot: created ticket PLAT-4521 to add `X-Model-Change-Notice` header + metric (owner: maria). ETA: 2 weeks.

sre-bot: canary: rolling header change landed in prod canary group at 10:42 UTC. No errors observed.

diane: Draft RFC snippet (will push PR):
```json
{
  "param": "model_version",
  "type": "string",
  "default": "implicit (no-change)",
  "response_header": "X-Model-Change-Notice / X-Model-Pinned",
  "soft_default_rollout": "2024-10-01 (feature-flag subset)",
  "hard_enforcement": "2025-01-01 (90-day notice preceding)",
  "compat_tests": "eval-suite diff threshold + CI gating"
}
```

alex: :thumbsup: Add entry to release notes and support playbook (how to respond to customer tickets about output changes).

maria: I'll update SDK trackers (python/js/go) and ping PLG slack once RFC PR is open.

kevin: Great. Diane — please open RFC PR by EOD. I'll schedule a 15m sync Fri 10:00 to confirm rollout groups and comms channels.

maria: noted, will prep migration checklist for SDK leads.

kevin: Thanks all — sticking point if anyone thinks 6 months is too long/short? If not, we'll go with plan.
